chapter.heading: A song for pilgrims going up to Jerusalem.
chapter.v:
I look
up to you, the one who rules from heaven.

Just as
servants look to their master, or a maid looks to her mistress, so we keep our eyes on you, Lord our God, waiting for you to be merciful to us.

Please have
mercy on us, Lord, have mercy. We've had enough of people's contempt.

We've had
more than enough of the scorn of the proud, and the contempt of the arrogant.
